product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides software for global enterprises to identify and resolve pay inequities, make compliant pay decisions, and streamline pay-transparency reporting.
product_one_liner.notes: Trusaic’s About page describes software for global enterprises to make precise, compliant pay decisions, achieve pay equity, and streamline pay-transparency reporting.

pricing_page.notes: The public ACA Complete Editions & Pricing page lists a plan and offers a price lookup after login. A public page listing editions and pricing qualifies even if the exact price is gated.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Trusaic’s Customer Advisory Board page names Envista, Thomson Reuters, and Alaska Airlines alongside their representatives. | named_customers.0: The Customer Advisory Board page pairs Envista with its representative. | named_customers.1: The Customer Advisory Board page includes a Thomson Reuters representative and logo. | named_customers.2: The Customer Advisory Board page includes an Alaska Airlines representative and logo.

employee_band.notes: The company record reports an official employee count of 121; the CEO interview separately says about 160 employees and contractors. Both figures fall in the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Trusaic company record lists Los Angeles as its location city. | hq_country: The Trusaic company record lists its location country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The 1999 announcement says Sheen founded First Capitol Consulting, and the 2019 announcement says that business became Trusaic. A separate Trusaic release refers to 2014 as the start of the Triangle of Trust methodology, creating some ambiguity about whether the brand or continuing business is being dated; 1999 is used for the business lineage.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a general corporate blog, and the reviewed material surfaced a single technical/build-oriented AI post rather than at least two engineering posts about how the product is built. Under the stated threshold, this is false.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation/footer links to resources and the corporate blog but does not expose a public product-docs, help-center, or developer-portal link. The trust-center materials are not a public multi-article product documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The employer job board showed a single Sales Development Representative position, not an AI, ML, or data-science role; the jobs page also reported no open jobs. Thus no qualifying AI/ML role was open.

model_provider.notes: The AI FAQ says customer data is not shared with public LLMs, while the DPA names Microsoft Azure as a cloud-hosting provider—not as the model provider. The reviewed AI blog and FAQ do not name an AI model or model provider, so this is unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company homepage’s trust-and-security badges name SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR, supporting these three entries. | compliance_certs.0: The homepage trust badges explicitly name SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The homepage trust badges explicitly name ISO 27001 as certified. | compliance_certs.2: The homepage trust badges explicitly say GDPR Compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The CEO says the company has taken on no outside funding, and the company record contains no funding rounds, so the stage is none. | funding_date: The company states it has taken on no outside funding, and its company record lists no rounds; therefore there is no funding date to provide. | funding_amount_usd: The CEO says the company has taken on no outside funding, and the company record shows no funding rounds. There is no most-recent round amount to report.

raised_18mo.notes: The CEO states there has been no outside funding, and the company record shows no funding rounds. Accordingly, it did not raise funding in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The employer’s Sales Development Representative listing says it is not accepting applications, and the jobs page says there are no open jobs. This supports no current SDR/BDR/AE hiring; third-party listings may be stale.

launched_6mo.notes: A May 20, 2026 announcement says Trusaic enhanced its EU Pay Transparency Directive monitor with a real-time interactive map. This major-feature announcement falls within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team page lists the leadership team; the profile data dates Lynn Kaiser’s Counsel and VP start to 2025-11-01, before the 2025-11-09 start of the lookback window. No qualifying C-level or VP-level join or departure was identified within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Trusaic job description explicitly names HubSpot CRM, Avoma, and ZoomInfo as tools used to manage and forecast its pipeline. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job description explicitly names HubSpot CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job description explicitly names Avoma. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job description explicitly names ZoomInfo.
